title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling until you are tired.
body:
We decided to build the opposite. At Headlinne, our philosophy is simple: news should respect your time rather than steal it. The current digital landscape is designed around constant engagement and infinite feeds, which often leaves readers feeling overwhelmed or anxious.

We use AI not to feed you more content, but to filter out the noise. Our goal is to surface the stories that actually matter to your specific interests, delivering them in a format that gets you informed and gets you on with your day. We believe that a smarter news experience is one where you feel in control of your intake.

It is about moving away from the endless scroll and toward intentional reading. Technology should be a tool that helps you understand the world, not a distraction that pulls you away from it. We are trying to prove that you can stay well-informed without burning out.
cta: You can see how we are rethinking the daily news cycle at HEADLINNE.com.
